nodes.Name: Static Mind
nodes.Text: Melee skills that deal Lightning damage hit harder.

nodes.Name: Frostbinder
nodes.Text: Projectiles that deal Cold damage hit harder.

nodes.Name: Meteor Lore
nodes.Text: Not on Thunderfall, Ember Spark, Drain Life, Living Orb or Glacial Shards (a socketed Skyfall gem still works there).
nodes.Flavour: Look up. The sky is handing your spells back.

nodes.Name: Swift Ward
nodes.Text: No diminishing returns.

nodes.Name: Reaper's Due
nodes.Text: Reaper's Communion: Your Poison Attacks hit harder for each Minion you command.

nodes.Name: Grave Pact
nodes.Flavour: A bone that falls for you gives a little back.

nodes.Name: Open Conduit
nodes.Flavour: Leave the door open while you work. Something will always come through.

nodes.Name: Fletcher's Focus
nodes.Text: Enemies your Projectiles kill, your Ballistas' bolts too, burst into splinters: 10% of that hit to enemies within 2 metres.

nodes.Name: Hoarfrost Fletching
nodes.Text: Cold skills land Critical Strikes more often.

nodes.Name: Deadeye Draw
nodes.Flavour: Draw slow. Loose once. Walk on.

nodes.Name: Fleet Shadow
nodes.Text: When your roll ends, the wind cuts around you: 30% of your last skill's hit to enemies within 2.5 metres (once every 2 seconds). No diminishing returns.

nodes.Name: Killing Field
nodes.Text: Your Totems and Ballistas Poison.

nodes.Name: Storm of Arrows
nodes.Flavour: Nobody in the Sylvan march aimed. They made it rain.

nodes.Name: Endless Edge
nodes.Text: Every fifth Melee hit cuts again: 20% of that hit to enemies within 2 metres.

nodes.Name: Flash Step
nodes.Text: Crescent Moon: Melee skills that throw Projectiles hit harder for each extra Projectile.

nodes.Name: Empty Hand
nodes.Flavour: The mountain king left his hammer at the gate. He did not need it.

nodes.Name: Second Shadow
nodes.Text: Your melee Movement skills (Shield Charge, Holy Charge, Iaido Thrust, Leap Slam, Moonfall) strike again where they land: a shadow repeats the hit, and both hits deal 20% less damage. Thousand Cuts, spell and bow dashes and channelled skills get no shadow.
nodes.Flavour: Strike once. Let the shadow you left behind strike again.

nodes.Name: Echo Cut
nodes.Text: Works on dashes: Iaido Thrust, Holy Charge, Shield Charge, Leap Slam, Moonfall, Wind Vault, Thousand Cuts (one more cut where you end), Flame Dash and Vampire Dash (the echo blinks you on again). Never on channelled skills such as Cyclone.

nodes.Name: Tremor Stance
nodes.Text: Your Slams also open Bleeding wounds. Breaking Ground: Your Slams hit harder the more the enemy is Maimed.

nodes.Name: Ceaseless Steel
nodes.Text: Channelled attacks like Cyclone make enemies Bleed.

nodes.Name: Evergreen Oath
nodes.Flavour: Cut the oak to the root and it still swears to the spring.

nodes.Name: Stalwart
nodes.Text: When an enemy hits you, you strike back for 40% of your skill's hit (at least 150% of the damage you took), more with your Block chance and Armour, to enemies within 3 metres (once every 0.5 seconds).

nodes.Name: Shield Wall
nodes.Text: Burning Bulwark: Your Shield skills hit harder the higher your chance to Block.

nodes.Name: Oathstone Body
nodes.Text: No diminishing returns.

nodes.Name: Second Battery
nodes.Flavour: The dwarves of the deep hall wound their engines by song. Ours just swear faster.
nodes._r110META: r110 META (trust, players: "+1 totem nodes vanished without a note"): the +1 engine the r108 FPS cap pass took from this node is back; engine tops stay 7 bow engines / 11 Totems (count past the top = OVERFLOW107 damage)

nodes.Name: Iaijutsu
nodes.Text: Dashes: Iaido Thrust, Shield Charge, Holy Charge, Leap Slam, Moonfall, Wind Vault, Thousand Cuts and the blinks. Channelled skills such as Cyclone are not dashes.

nodes.Name: Mountainhold
nodes.Text: When an enemy hits you, you strike back for 40% of your skill's hit (at least 150% of the damage you took), more with your Block chance and Armour, to enemies within 3 metres (once every 0.5 seconds).
nodes.Flavour: Under the mountain they held one gate for three hundred years. You only need to hold this one.

nodes.Name: Feast of the Void
nodes.Flavour: The void is never full. Neither, now, are you.

nodes.Name: Thirsting Steel
nodes.Flavour: The blade drinks, and the arm that swings it stays fresh.

nodes.Name: Sworn Surge
nodes.Text: Critical strikes grant 50% more elemental damage for 8 seconds.
nodes.Price: Your critical strike multiplier is 100%.

nodes.Name: Twice-Fallen Sky
nodes.Text: Every Skyfall strike falls twice: a second impact 0.4 seconds later for 10% of the damage. Other second fall sources, such as Twice Judged, Starcaller's Staff and Skyfire, add to the same impact, up to 100%.
nodes.Price: Skyfall skills have 50% increased mana cost and have 20% less area.
nodes.Flavour: What falls once was an accident. What falls twice was an oath.

nodes.Name: Glass Cannon
nodes.Text: 12% more Spell Damage and 25% increased Damage. Your minions deal 12% more Damage.
nodes.Price: You cannot Evade. You cannot Leech Life. You take 15% increased Damage.

nodes.Name: Heartspend
nodes.Text: Skills cost Life instead of Mana. 30% more maximum Life.
nodes.Price: You have no Mana.

nodes.Name: Marrow Lord
nodes.Text: +1 to the maximum number of each kind of minion.
nodes.Price: Your Vows, Heralds and Woes reserve 15% more mana. 6% less maximum Life and Energy Shield. Your minions deal 6% less damage.
nodes._d25n9_BRAIN: WTCOUNT253 (rule 67 count line, rule 68 cut by numbers): +1 each kind of minion is ~x1.12 on a 4-summon army; a summoner now pays 6% less minion damage (was hero-side prices only).

nodes.Name: Pyre Covenant
nodes.Text: Your minions explode on death for 60% of their hit damage as Fire damage to enemies within 2.5 metres. +1 to the maximum number of each kind of minion.
nodes.Price: Your minions have 10% less Life. Your minions deal 6% less damage.
nodes.Flavour: They swore to follow you into the fire. You held them to it.
nodes._d25n9_BRAIN: WTCOUNT253 (rule 67 count line, rule 68 cut by numbers): +1 each kind of minion is ~x1.12 on a 4-summon army; a summoner now pays 6% less minion damage (was hero-side prices only).

nodes.Name: Cascade of Ruin
nodes.Text: Your Ignites deal 60% more damage.
nodes.Price: Your hits cannot deal critical strikes.
nodes.Flavour: One falls, and the rest of the forest follows.

nodes.Name: Hawk's Patience
nodes.Text: Bow attacks pierce all targets.
nodes.Price: You cannot deal critical strikes with spells.

nodes.Name: Leaping Ruin
nodes.Text: Chains no longer lose damage. Your Chain skills deal 8% more damage and 15% increased damage.
nodes.Price: 5% less damage to the first target hit by a Chain.

nodes.Name: Thousand Hands
nodes.Text: 15% more Attack Speed while Dual Wielding, and 15% more with Fists and Claws. 0.6% of Melee damage is Leeched as Life. Every eighth Melee hit releases a ring of blades: 40% of that hit to enemies within 2 metres.
nodes.Price: -6% to maximum Fire, Cold and Lightning Resistances.
nodes.Flavour: Two blades, two fists, a thousand answers.

nodes.Name: Way of the Blade
nodes.Text: Your melee attacks repeat once. On Flurry, Soul Rend, Thunderfall, Twin Cuts and Viper Fang every blow repeats, and every cut of Thousand Cuts. Channelled skills such as Cyclone never repeat. Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage.
nodes.Price: 28% less attack damage.

nodes.Name: One Breath
nodes.Text: +50% to Critical Strike Multiplier. Your Attack critical strikes cut again: 25% of the hit to enemies within 2 metres (at most twice a second).
nodes.Price: 20% less Attack Speed. Your Spells cannot deal critical strikes.
nodes.Flavour: One breath in. One cut. The second breath is for the living.

nodes.Name: Unbroken Wall
nodes.Text: +10% Chance to Block while holding a Shield. Your Attacks deal 12% more damage and 25% increased damage while you hold a Shield. When you Block, the shield strikes back: 60% of your last skill's hit as Physical damage to enemies within 2 metres (once a second).
nodes.Price: You cannot Evade and your maximum Elemental Resistances are 3% lower: the wall turns blows, not the storm.
nodes.Flavour: The gate of the deep hall never moved. Neither did the dwarves who held it.

nodes.Name: Wake of Spells
nodes.Text: All your Channelling skills are supported by Channel Conduit, which casts twice as often: your spin leaves a wake of your linked spell.
nodes.Price: Conduit spells deal 10% less damage. Channelling costs 30% more.
nodes.Flavour: In the eye of the storm, every word you ever spoke comes back around.

nodes.Name: Iron Resolve
nodes.Text: Armour reduces elemental hits at half value; 90% total at most.
nodes.Price: You cannot evade.

nodes.Name: Edgecaster
nodes.Text: Increases and reductions to Spell damage also apply to your Attacks. 50% increased Spell damage.
nodes.Price: Your Spells cast 10% slower. Your Attacks are not slowed.

nodes.Name: Sanctified
nodes.Text: Gain 25% of Physical damage as extra Fire damage. 60% increased Damage with Holy Spells.
nodes.Price: 5% less Attack Damage. Your Spells have 25% increased Mana cost.

nodes.Name: Ancestral Host
nodes.Text: +3 to the maximum number of Ballistas and Totems. Your Ballistas and Totems have 40% increased Life. Each Totem or Ballista past the first deals 50% less damage.
nodes.Price: You deal no damage with skills you use yourself (totems, minions and conduits still do).
nodes.Flavour: The host knows its oaths by heart. It can hold them without your hands.

nodes.Name: Hollow Covenant
nodes.Text: Regenerate 0.035% of Life per second for every 1% of uncapped Poison Resistance.
nodes.Price: -5% to maximum Fire and Lightning Resistances. You cannot leech Life.
nodes.Flavour: The hollow do not bleed. Somewhere under the mountain, the old dwarves knew it too.

nodes.Name: Siege Pact
nodes.Text: +1 to the maximum number of Ballistas and Totems. Your Ballistas and Totems fire an extra projectile. Each Totem or Ballista past the first deals 50% less damage.
nodes.Price: 5% less maximum Life and Energy Shield.
nodes.Flavour: The engine-wrights paid for every bolt in blood. So will you.

nodes.Name: Forked Sky
nodes.Text: Your projectiles Fork once when they hit.
nodes.Price: 5% less Projectile Damage.
nodes.Flavour: An arrow is a question. Now it asks twice.

nodes.Name: Tempest Vow
nodes.Text: Your Channelling skills are supported by Lightning and Tether: your spin calls lightning down onto what it cuts, and every enemy it hits is linked to 2 more (the link works on Cyclone and Drain Life).
nodes.Price: Channelling skills deal 5% less damage.
nodes.Flavour: The two schools argued for a hundred years. Then the storm settled it.

nodes.Name: Hammer of Judgement
nodes.Text: Every second Slam calls 3 Sky Swords down where it lands, each dealing 55% of the Slam's hit (once every 0.6 seconds). Your Slams deal 0.375% more damage for every 1,000 Armour you have. Adds together with your other stat engines into one more.
nodes.Price: 8% less Attack Damage.
nodes.Flavour: The anvil asks. The sky answers.

nodes.Name: Dawnstorm Covenant
nodes.Text: Your Spell critical strikes (Glacial Shards and Thunderfall count as Spells) call a pillar of dawn onto the enemy for 45% of the hit as Fire damage (each enemy at most once a second).
nodes.Price: -25% to Critical Strike Multiplier.
nodes.Flavour: The tower and the temple shared one window. Through it, the dawn.

nodes.Name: Choir of Bones
nodes.Text: Your Minions' Projectile skills are supported by Chain (its usual 5% less Damage, no socket, no extra Mana cost): every Skeletal Mage bolt leaps to 2 more enemies. Your Minions' Projectile skills deal 12% more Damage.
nodes.Price: Your Minions have 5% less Life.
nodes.Flavour: They learned the old words. They sing them badly, and everything dies anyway.

nodes.Name: The Hunting Dead
nodes.Text: Your Minions range ahead and hunt (Ravening Host). Enemies you kill with any Projectile-tagged skill (melee ones like Crescent Slash too; not Rain of Arrows) burst in a plague cloud: 30% of the killing hit as Poison damage within 2.5 metres.
nodes.Price: Your Minions have 15% less Life.
nodes.Flavour: The hounds were dead before the hunt began. It did not slow them.

nodes.Name: Oath of Wind and Steel
nodes.Text: Your Melee attacks repeat once as a ghost of the swing (Afterimage, its usual 20% less Damage), except Cyclone and the dashes (Iaido Thrust, Holy Charge, Shield Charge, Leap Slam, Moonfall). On Flurry, Soul Rend, Thunderfall, Twin Cuts and Viper Fang every blow repeats, and every cut of Thousand Cuts. Your Bow attacks Fork, except Rain of Arrows, Wind Vault and Piercing Shot. Neither needs a socket or extra Mana. 20% increased Attack Speed.
nodes.Price: 10% reduced Evasion.
nodes.Flavour: The blade remembers the arrow. The arrow remembers the blade.

nodes.Name: Earthbreaker Stride
nodes.Text: Your Movement skills (Thousand Cuts counts) end in an eruption: 5 spikes break the ground under enemies within 3.5 metres for 80% of your best skill hit of the last 4 seconds (once a second).
nodes.Price: 8% reduced Movement Speed.
nodes.Flavour: Where the samurai stepped, the warrior's ground broke.

nodes.Name: Hammer and Shield
nodes.Text: When an enemy hits you, you strike back for 40% of your skill's hit (at least 150% of the damage you took), more with your Block chance and Armour, to enemies within 3 metres (once every 0.5 seconds).

nodes.Name: Aegis Rebuke
nodes.Text: When you Block, holy fire bursts from you: 120% of your last skill's hit as Fire damage to enemies within 3 metres (once every 0.6 seconds).
nodes.Price: You take 5% increased Physical damage.
nodes.Flavour: The shield is a door, and the fire is behind it.

nodes.Name: Comet Step
nodes.Text: Your roll ends in a burst of dawn fire: 300% of your last skill's hit as Fire damage to enemies within 4 metres (once every 1.5 seconds).
nodes.Price: 8% reduced Energy Shield. 4% reduced maximum Life.
nodes.Flavour: Fall like a star. Land like a sermon.

nodes.Name: Sanctified Wrath
nodes.Flavour: The oath was waiting for a voice.

nodes.Name: Litany of Rot
nodes.Text: Your sweeping Melee Area strikes Poison.
nodes.Flavour: Speak the Woe slowly. Let every word take root.

nodes.Name: Unbroken Litany
nodes.Flavour: A Vow kept costs less with every dawn it survives.

nodes.Name: Thunder of the Jarls
nodes.Text: The Jarl's Host: Your Totems hit harder for every Fury charge you hold.
nodes.Flavour: The old kings did not draw steel first. They drew breath.

nodes.Name: Long Echo
nodes.Flavour: A spell that ends is a spell that was rushed.

nodes.Name: Twofold Woe
nodes.Flavour: One sorrow is a burden. Two are a sentence.

nodes.Name: Dawnsworn Blade
nodes.Flavour: The vow is spoken with the edge, not the mouth.

nodes.Name: Dawnmarch
nodes.Text: Every third Holy Melee hit (Holy Slash, Holy Charge, Hallowed Slam; not Hammer Blow) calls a pillar of dawn onto the enemy for 50% of the hit as Fire damage (each enemy at most once a second). You deal 0.3% more damage for every 1% chance to Block you have.
nodes.Price: 10% less Attack Speed.
nodes.Flavour: Every third blow belongs to the morning.

nodes.Name: Carrion Hymn
nodes.Text: Pyre of Rot: Your Corpse skills hit harder the higher your chance to Poison.
nodes.Flavour: Sing it low. The rot hears everything.

nodes.Name: Rotting Gospel
nodes.Text: Every fourth Poison Spell hit bursts: 40% of the hit as Poison damage to enemies within 2.5 metres. 6% more Damage and 20% increased Damage with Poison Spells. 15% increased Effect of your Curses.
nodes.Price: 5% less Cast Speed. 5% less Attack Speed.
nodes.Flavour: The dead were the first congregation. You preach to the living now.

nodes.Name: Graveside Sermon
nodes.Flavour: The dead keep perfect silence. Someone has to speak for them.

nodes.Name: Long Winter
nodes.Flavour: Cast once. Let the winter do the rest.

nodes.Name: Thunderhead
nodes.Flavour: One more spark than the sky can hold.

nodes.Name: Ancestral Vigil
nodes.Flavour: The ancestors are tireless, and they are waiting.

nodes.Name: Circle of Stones
nodes.Flavour: Another stone in the ring. Each one stands its ground.
nodes._r110META: r110 META (trust, players: "+1 totem nodes vanished without a note"): the +1 engine the r108 FPS cap pass took from this node is back; engine tops stay 7 bow engines / 11 Totems (count past the top = OVERFLOW107 damage)

nodes.Name: Legion of One
nodes.Flavour: One kind. Twice as many. They do not share the grave.

nodes.Name: Harmony
nodes.Text: Every different kind of Minion you command makes the whole army stronger.
nodes.Flavour: The wall holds, the bows sing, the banner burns. Each needs the other.

nodes.Name: Consecrated Guardian
nodes.Flavour: It was a knight once. It kept the vow past the grave, and now the vow keeps it.

nodes.Name: Host of the Oath
nodes.Flavour: Two shields of light. The oath is heavier for it.

nodes.Name: Bloodlust
nodes.Flavour: Every kill a drumbeat. Stop, and the drum falls silent.

nodes.Name: Bloodlust
nodes.Flavour: Every kill a drumbeat. Stop, and the drum falls silent.

nodes.Name: War Banner
nodes.Flavour: Plant it where the fight is. Leave it where the fight was won.

nodes.Name: War Banner
nodes.Flavour: Plant it where the fight is. Leave it where the fight was won.

nodes.Name: Hunter's Mark
nodes.Flavour: One arrow finds the gap. The next ten widen it.

nodes.Name: Hunter's Mark
nodes.Flavour: One arrow finds the gap. The next ten widen it.

nodes.Name: Road of the Hunt
nodes.Flavour: The quarry does not care whose bow it was.

nodes.Name: Road of Bloodlust
nodes.Flavour: A borrowed hunger burns longest.

nodes.Name: Road of the Banner
nodes.Flavour: Any hand may raise a standard. Few can hold it.

nodes.Name: Road of the Hunt
nodes.Flavour: The quarry does not care whose bow it was.

nodes.Name: Road of the Banner
nodes.Flavour: Any hand may raise a standard. Few can hold it.

nodes.Name: Road of Bloodlust
nodes.Flavour: A borrowed hunger burns longest.

nodes.Name: Heavy Blows
nodes.Flavour: Hit it hard enough and it stays down.

nodes.Name: Marrowcrack
nodes.Flavour: Find the crack. Then widen it.

nodes.Name: Steady Iron
nodes.Flavour: The weapon is only as heavy as the hand that refuses to let go.

nodes.Name: Weight of the Mountain
nodes.Flavour: Stone does not dodge.

nodes.Name: Brutal Rhythm
nodes.Flavour: One swing. The next. The next.

nodes.Name: Shade of the Blow
nodes.Flavour: Strike once. The air strikes again.

nodes.Name: Sure Strike
nodes.Text: 40% more Physical Attack damage. Your Bleeding deals 36% more damage. Each Slam hit shakes the ground for 15% of that hit within 2 metres, the enemy struck included.
nodes.Flavour: The mountain knows where it will fall.
nodes.Price: Your Attacks cannot deal critical strikes, except The Final Draw.

nodes.Name: Mountainblood
nodes.Flavour: Some are born to carry the mountain.

nodes.Name: Mountainborn
nodes.Text: Every 10 Strength also gives you 0.75% more Physical Attack damage. Adds together with your other stat engines into one more.
nodes.Flavour: You are a weapon down to the last ounce.
nodes.Price: 8% less Attack Damage.

nodes.Name: Forge Heat
nodes.Text: Slams that deal Fire damage Ignite more often and burn harder.
nodes.Flavour: The forge is still in the steel.

nodes.Name: Purifying Flame
nodes.Flavour: What the light touches, it keeps burning.

nodes.Name: Thunder Oath
nodes.Flavour: Swear it loud enough and the sky answers.

nodes.Name: Storm Fletching
nodes.Flavour: Feathers cut from a storm crow.

nodes.Name: Winter Fletching
nodes.Flavour: The arrow lands. The frost stays.

nodes.Name: Rimelock
nodes.Flavour: Winter is patient. So are you.

nodes.Name: Black Blood
nodes.Flavour: It kills slowly. It has the time.

nodes.Name: Venom Tips
nodes.Flavour: A scratch is enough.

nodes.Name: Blood Remembers
nodes.Flavour: The first quiet room is not the end of the hunt.

nodes.Name: The Long Hunt
nodes.Text: While an enemy you Sentenced is alive, your Bloodlust does not run out.
nodes.Flavour: The sentence is spoken. The hunt waits for it.
nodes.Price: 10 less maximum Bloodlust. Your Bloodlust runs out 30% sooner.

nodes.Name: Heavy Hand
nodes.Flavour: Lift it once. Let it fall forever.

nodes.Name: Clean Cut
nodes.Flavour: One cut. Nothing left to fix.

nodes.Name: Held Breath
nodes.Flavour: Breathe out. Loose.

nodes.Name: Righteous Arm
nodes.Flavour: The arm is steel. The will is fire.

nodes.Name: Endless War
nodes.Flavour: The war is not over. It is never over.

nodes.Name: Blade Hunger
nodes.Flavour: A clean cut feeds the next.

nodes.Name: Hunter's Creed
nodes.Flavour: Each arrow follows the one before.

nodes.Name: Standard of the Oath
nodes.Flavour: Where it stands, the line holds.

nodes.Name: Bone Scholar
nodes.Flavour: The dead keep the best notes.

nodes.Name: Frost of the Grave
nodes.Text: When one of your minions falls, it bursts in frost: half of your last skill's hit as Cold damage to enemies within 2.5 metres (once every 0.5 seconds).
nodes.Flavour: Cold hands. Colder spells.

nodes.Name: Carrion Arrows
nodes.Flavour: Dip it in the grave first.

nodes.Name: Blight Hunter
nodes.Text: Enemies your Projectiles kill burst in poison: 30% of that hit to enemies within 2.5 metres.
nodes.Flavour: The wound is the second arrow.

nodes.Name: Bow and Blade
nodes.Flavour: Far or near, the same calm.

nodes.Name: Edge of the Wind
nodes.Text: When your roll ends, the wind cuts around you: half of your last skill's hit to enemies within 3 metres (once every 1.5 seconds).
nodes.Flavour: Know the wind. Cut through it.

nodes.Name: Two Schools
nodes.Flavour: One teacher said strike hard. The other said strike true.

nodes.Name: Blood and Steel
nodes.Text: When an enemy hits you, your blade answers: 60% of your last skill's hit to enemies within 2.5 metres (once a second).
nodes.Flavour: Both teachers were right.

nodes.Name: Holy Forge
nodes.Flavour: Steel, blessed in the fire.

nodes.Name: Burning Crusade
nodes.Text: Every fourth Melee hit bursts in holy fire: 60% of that hit to enemies within 2.5 metres.
nodes.Flavour: Every blow a prayer. Every prayer a fire.

nodes.Name: Spell and Sword
nodes.Flavour: Read the book. Then swing it.

nodes.Name: Stormblade
nodes.Text: Every fourth Melee hit calls lightning down: 35% of that hit to enemies within 2 metres.
nodes.Flavour: Lightning, held in a blade.

nodes.Name: Dwarven Rune Socket
nodes.Text: An empty Dwarven Rune Socket. From Rupture Level 110 you can set a Dwarven Rune here, and swap it for free.
nodes.Flavour: Old dwarf-work. It waits for a rune.

nodes.Name: Dwarven Rune Socket
nodes.Text: An empty Dwarven Rune Socket. From Rupture Level 110 you can set a Dwarven Rune here, and swap it for free.
nodes.Flavour: Old dwarf-work. It waits for a rune.

nodes.Text: An empty Dwarven Rune Socket. From Rupture Level 110 you can set a Dwarven Rune here, and swap it for free.
nodes.Flavour: Old dwarf-work. It waits for a rune.

nodes.Name: Dwarven Rune Socket
nodes.Text: An empty Dwarven Rune Socket. From Rupture Level 110 you can set a Dwarven Rune here, and swap it for free.
nodes.Flavour: Old dwarf-work. It waits for a rune.

nodes.Name: Hall-Shaker
nodes.Flavour: The hall went quiet before the jarl spoke. It never stayed quiet after.

nodes.Name: Stillwater Step
nodes.Flavour: The pond waits, and the moon comes down to it.

nodes.Name: Quick Ink
nodes.Flavour: The fastest pen in the library also picked its locks.

nodes.Name: Stonecarrier
nodes.Flavour: The tallest tower went up one stone at a time.

nodes.Name: Star Reckoning
nodes.Flavour: She read the sky before every long shot.

nodes.Name: Bowyer's Back
nodes.Flavour: A war bow is drawn with the back, not the arms.

nodes.Name: Saga Memory
nodes.Flavour: The old jarls knew a hundred battles by heart. They won the hundred and first.

nodes.Name: Light Feet
nodes.Flavour: Heavy steel, quick feet. The dead had it the other way round.

nodes.Name: Gravedigger's Arm
nodes.Flavour: Somebody has to dig them up first.

nodes.Name: Road-Worn Feet
nodes.Flavour: A thousand miles of road teach the feet their own prayers.

nodes.Name: Brush and Blade
nodes.Flavour: The same hand writes the poem and draws the sword.

nodes.Name: Bitter Cold
nodes.Flavour: Cold is patient. It only has to be patient once.

nodes.Name: Hoarfrost Mantle
nodes.Flavour: The frost on your coat is older than your oath.

nodes.Name: Winter's Grip
nodes.Flavour: Spring was a promise. You did not make it.

nodes.Name: Oath of the Long Night
nodes.Text: Every third Cold hit bursts into frost: 50% of the hit as Cold damage to enemies within 2.5 metres. 16% more Cold damage and 22% increased Cold damage. 30% increased chill and freeze build-up.
nodes.Price: 10% less Attack Speed.
nodes.Flavour: The night has no end. It is waiting for you to stop.

nodes.Name: Banked Embers
nodes.Text: Your Movement skills Ignite.
nodes.Flavour: Feed a fire a little each hour and it will outlast you.

nodes.Name: Ashen Vigil
nodes.Flavour: Keep watch by the pyre. It keeps watch by you.

nodes.Name: Long Smoulder
nodes.Flavour: The second hour of a fire is worse than the first.

nodes.Name: Oath of the Pyre
nodes.Text: Every fourth hit against a Burning enemy bursts: 40% of the hit as Fire damage to enemies within 2.5 metres. +10% chance to Ignite. 40% increased Burning damage (your Ignites). 8% more Fire damage and 15% increased Fire damage.
nodes.Price: 8% reduced maximum Life and Energy Shield.
nodes.Flavour: Vows are kindling. Yours burned the brightest.

nodes.Name: Tripwire Patience
nodes.Flavour: The best hunter is the one who was never there.

nodes.Name: Hidden Hide
nodes.Flavour: Lie still long enough and the forest forgets you.

nodes.Name: Cruel Teeth
nodes.Flavour: A trap cannot miss. It waits for its moment.

nodes.Name: Oath of the Snare
nodes.Text: Your Traps deal 18% more Damage and 30% increased Damage, strike 25% wider and have 50% increased Critical Chance.
nodes.Price: 10% less Cast and Attack Speed.
nodes.Flavour: You don't fight. You arrive when it is over.

nodes.Name: Tempered Hide
nodes.Flavour: Iron learns the forge. So does the hide that wears it.

nodes.Name: Hearth-Forged
nodes.Flavour: The blow arrives as iron and leaves as embers.

nodes.Name: Weathered Cloak
nodes.Flavour: Rain, frost and lightning taught the cloth what the arrow could not.

nodes.Name: Storm-Tempered Breath
nodes.Flavour: Breathe in the storm. Let the blade pass through it.

nodes.Name: Warded Flesh
nodes.Flavour: The ward takes the hammer and turns it into weather.

nodes.Name: Grave-Cold Marrow
nodes.Flavour: Dead bone goes cold long before it breaks.

nodes.Name: Gathering Storm
nodes.Flavour: One bolt is weather. Two is a warning.

nodes.Name: Arc Contagion
nodes.Flavour: The storm goes on past the man it struck.

nodes.Name: Stormbrim
nodes.Flavour: Hold the charge a heartbeat longer.

nodes.Name: Oath of the Living Storm
nodes.Text: Your Shocks stack: 2 more Shocks can sit on an enemy (3 in all), adding up to at most 75% more damage taken (each Shock scales with the Lightning in its hit). When a Shocked enemy dies, its Shock has a 75% chance to spread to enemies within 4.5 metres. +35% chance to Shock.
nodes.Price: Your Shocks have 5% less effect.
nodes.Flavour: The sky heard your oath, and holds you to it.

nodes.Name: Forest Blaze
nodes.Flavour: Burn one tree and you have burned the forest.

nodes.Name: Kindled Flesh
nodes.Flavour: A second fire on the same coal burns hotter.

nodes.Name: Fanned Flames
nodes.Flavour: The wind is the arsonist's best friend.

nodes.Name: Oath of Many Fires
nodes.Text: Your Ignites stack: 3 more Ignites burn on an enemy at once (4 in all). When a Burning enemy dies, its Ignite has a 75% chance to spread to enemies within 4.5 metres. You deal 2% more Fire damage for every 100 maximum Mana you have. Adds together with your other stat engines into one more.
nodes.Price: Your Ignites deal 10% less damage.
nodes.Flavour: Many small fires. One great burning.

nodes.Name: Shatterglass
nodes.Flavour: Frozen things break cleanly. Mostly.

nodes.Name: Biting Cold
nodes.Flavour: The cold is painless. It just takes.

nodes.Name: Shardfall
nodes.Flavour: No shard lands alone.

nodes.Name: Oath of the White Silence
nodes.Text: Chilled and Frozen enemies you kill shatter for 25% of their maximum Life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as Cold damage to enemies within 3.5 metres, chilling them. 80% increased effect of Chill. 40% increased Freeze duration and Crack damage.
nodes.Price: Your hits cannot Ignite or Shock.
nodes.Flavour: Snow falls on the battlefield. Nothing else moves.

nodes.Name: Open Veins
nodes.Flavour: The axe only has to open the door. The blood does the rest.

nodes.Name: Hamstring
nodes.Flavour: Run, and bleed faster.

nodes.Name: Blood in the Water
nodes.Flavour: The wolves smell it before you do.

nodes.Name: Oath of the Red Harvest
nodes.Text: Your Physical hits always cause Bleeding. 15% more Bleeding damage and 30% increased Bleeding damage. +15% to Damage over Time Multiplier.
nodes.Price: 50% less Life Leech.
nodes.Flavour: The field is red. The harvest is in.

nodes.Name: Crimson Edge
nodes.Flavour: The cut is so clean the enemy does not notice. Yet.

nodes.Name: Ribbon of Red
nodes.Flavour: It trails behind them like a banner.

nodes.Name: Tide of Wounds
nodes.Flavour: Small wounds. Many of them. Patience.

nodes.Name: Oath of a Thousand Cuts
nodes.Text: +30% chance to cause Bleeding with Physical hits. 30% increased Bleeding damage. +30% to Damage over Time Multiplier. Your Melee attacks and Orbit skills deal 2% more damage for every 10% increased Attack Speed you have. Adds together with your other stat engines into one more.
nodes.Price: -50% to Critical Strike Multiplier.
nodes.Flavour: The master strikes lightly. The master strikes often.

nodes.Name: Lingering Ruin
nodes.Flavour: What the hit begins, the hour completes.

nodes.Name: Septic Blood
nodes.Flavour: The wound is the doorway. The rot walks in.

nodes.Name: Slow Decay
nodes.Flavour: Nothing in the grave is ever in a hurry.

nodes.Name: Oath of Slow Ruin
nodes.Text: +30% to Damage over Time Multiplier, added to your other multipliers: your Ignites, Poisons and Bleeding deal more.
nodes.Price: 10% reduced maximum Life and Energy Shield.
nodes.Flavour: Everything ends. You see to it.

nodes.Name: Storm Quiver
nodes.Flavour: Your arrows carry a little of the sky.

nodes.Name: Forked Contagion
nodes.Flavour: The bolt leaves the corpse looking for another.

nodes.Name: Arcing Pulse
nodes.Flavour: Pull the string tighter. Let the storm wait.

nodes.Name: Brushfire
nodes.Flavour: The blade passes. The grass behind it burns.

nodes.Name: Searing Edge
nodes.Flavour: A cut that keeps on cutting.

nodes.Name: Forge Breath
nodes.Flavour: Steel remembers the fire that made it.

nodes.Name: Glass Saints
nodes.Flavour: Even the faithful break when frozen.

nodes.Name: Black Ice
nodes.Flavour: The vigil lasts until the thaw. There is no thaw.

nodes.Name: Frost Relic
nodes.Flavour: Cold enough to keep a saint.

nodes.Name: Patient Storm
nodes.Flavour: The sky is in no hurry. It only has to be there when you look up.

nodes.Name: Ember Fletching
nodes.Flavour: Pitch on the shaft, a spark on the string. The rest is the wind's work.

nodes.Name: Mage Waygate
nodes.Flavour: Links to the 6 other Waygates.

nodes.Name: Necromancer Waygate
nodes.Flavour: Links to the 6 other Waygates.

nodes.Name: Ranger Waygate
nodes.Flavour: Links to the 6 other Waygates.

nodes.Name: Samurai Waygate
nodes.Flavour: Links to the 6 other Waygates.

nodes.Name: Warrior Waygate
nodes.Flavour: Links to the 6 other Waygates.

nodes.Name: Paladin Waygate
nodes.Flavour: Links to the 6 other Waygates.

nodes.Name: Eye of the Gale
nodes.Flavour: The sparks I leave behind are still listening.

nodes.Name: Pitch Battery
nodes.Flavour: Light the rack, then step back.

nodes.Name: Hidden Edge
nodes.Text: Your Traps make enemies Bleed.
nodes.Flavour: The cut lands before the step does.

nodes.Name: Grave Mending
nodes.Flavour: What I raise, I keep.

nodes.Name: Bone Sovereign
nodes.Text: +1 to the maximum number of each of your minions. It does not add a Golem: your Golems get 30% more life and damage instead. Your minions deal 45% increased damage.
nodes.Price: You deal 40% less damage yourself.
nodes._r110META: r110 META (owner 18 Nov 14:3x '+1 all minions node without not allowing him to attack ... doesn't work on golem so say it'): NoHeroDamage flag -> hero Damage 40% less (untagged Damage on a summon is cut by the r53 minion rule, BOStats.cpp ~1964, so minions keep full damage); Fp kept = owned heroes keep the point. Revert .pre_r110_META4.

nodes.Name: Litany of Dawn
nodes.Text: Pyre Wardens: Your Totems hit harder for each of your Ignites burning on the enemy.
nodes.Flavour: I speak the old words, and the ground answers.

nodes.Name: Scholar's Blood
nodes.Flavour: Some minds are too wide for one lifetime.

nodes.Name: Boundless Mind
nodes.Text: Every 10 Intelligence also gives you 0.5% more Spell damage. Adds together with your other stat engines into one more.
nodes.Flavour: Your thoughts are spells in waiting.
nodes.Price: 10% less Cast Speed. Your Minions deal 15% less Damage.

nodes.Name: Oath of the Rolling Thunder
nodes.Text: Your Shocks stack: 2 more Shocks can sit on an enemy (3 in all), adding up to at most 75% more damage taken (each Shock scales with the Lightning in its hit). When a Shocked enemy dies, its Shock has a 75% chance to spread to enemies within 4.5 metres. +25% chance to Shock.
nodes.Price: Your Shocks have 10% less effect.
nodes.Flavour: One arrow is a cloud. A volley is the storm.

nodes.Name: Quickened Sigils
nodes.Flavour: The second word is always faster than the first.

nodes.Name: Unquiet Ranks
nodes.Flavour: They do not wait to be called twice.

nodes.Name: Tireless Vigil
nodes.Flavour: Faith takes no rest between prayers.

nodes.Name: Ready Quiver
nodes.Flavour: The next arrow is already on the string.

nodes.Name: Second Draw
nodes.Flavour: Steel returns to the hand before the sheath is cold.

nodes.Name: Unbroken Rhythm
nodes.Flavour: Strike, breathe, strike again.

nodes.Name: Bastion's Reckoning
nodes.Text: Your Armour hits back: 0.8% more Damage for every 1,000 Armour. No diminishing returns. Adds together with your other stat engines into one more.
nodes.Flavour: The blows they failed to land, I return.
nodes.Price: 6% less Attack and Cast Speed.

nodes.Name: Feast of the Fallen
nodes.Flavour: What falls to them feeds them.

nodes.Name: Hunter's Blood
nodes.Flavour: The quarry never hears the second step.

nodes.Name: Thousand Feathers
nodes.Text: Every 10 Dexterity also gives you 0.3% more Projectile Attack damage (Rain of Arrows too). Adds together with your other stat engines into one more.
nodes.Flavour: A thousand feathers, and every one of them aimed.
nodes.Price: 10% less Attack Speed.

nodes.Name: Road Hunger
nodes.Flavour: The road is the first enemy and the last.

nodes.Name: Road Hunger

nodes.Flavour: One oath, one blade, one answer.
nodes.Price: Your other skills deal 30% less damage.

nodes.Name: Shield of Dawn

nodes.Name: Dawnward Rite
nodes.Flavour: A prayer said behind a shield is said twice.

nodes.Name: Spring-Loaded

nodes.Name: Wider Wires
nodes.Flavour: One wire, strung across the whole road.

nodes.Name: Patient Ambush
nodes.Flavour: They always come back the way they ran.

nodes.Name: Starmarked Quarry
nodes.Flavour: Each star you call follows the last one down.

nodes.Name: Grave Standard
nodes.Flavour: The dead march where the standard stands.

nodes.Name: Kindled Steel
nodes.Text: Physical and Fire bonuses both raise the converted share. Fire crit, area and ailment lines apply once Fire is most of the hit. No conversion with Brutality or Melee Physical damage linked.

nodes.Name: Hoarfrost Temper
nodes.Text: Physical and Cold bonuses both raise the converted share. Cold crit, area and ailment lines apply once Cold is most of the hit. No conversion with Brutality or Melee Physical damage linked.

nodes.Name: Storm Tempered
nodes.Text: Physical and Lightning bonuses both raise the converted share. Lightning crit, area and ailment lines apply once Lightning is most of the hit. No conversion with Brutality or Melee Physical damage linked.

nodes.Name: Consecrated Steel
nodes.Text: Holy skills only: the rest of their damage turns Physical and feeds your Physical bonuses.

nodes.Name: Festering Edge
nodes.Text: Physical and Poison bonuses both raise the converted share. Poison crit, area and ailment lines apply once Poison is most of the hit.

nodes.Name: Anvil Stance
nodes.Text: After you stand still for 0.8 seconds, your Slam skills deal 10% more damage until you move.

nodes.Name: Red Rage
nodes.Text: While you are below half life, your attacks have 50% reduced Mana cost and 12% more attack speed.

nodes.Name: Hunter's Patience
nodes.Text: After you stand still for 0.8 seconds, your Bow skills (Ballistas too) deal 12% more damage until you move.

nodes.Name: Martyr's Vow
nodes.Text: While you are below half life, your Holy Auras (Pyre of Faith) deal 25% more damage.

nodes.Name: Reaper's Tithe
nodes.Text: While wielding a Scythe, your Minions have 25% increased mana Reservation Efficiency.

nodes.Name: Wild Quiver
nodes.Text: While wielding a Bow, your Traps and Totems (the Ballista too) have +20% chance to Poison.

nodes.Name: Grave Hunger
nodes.Text: Corpses your minions make stay fresh 3 seconds longer and count twice for Feast.

nodes.Name: Charnel Court
nodes.Text: Up to 5 corpses within 4 metres of you that died in the last 6 seconds each count as one of your minions for effects that grow with minion count. They do not fight.

nodes.Name: Wand Duelist
nodes.Text: While wielding a Wand, your Spell critical hits always Ignite, Shock, Chill or Poison by the element they deal.

nodes.Name: Hollow Crown
nodes.Text: Your Woes have 2% more effect for each minion you have (at most 20%).
nodes.Price: 15% less maximum Life and Energy Shield.

nodes.Name: Dirge of the Hold
nodes.Text: While you channel a skill, your minions attack and cast 15% faster.

nodes.Name: Hallowed Stand
nodes.Text: After you stand still for 0.8 seconds, the ground under you becomes Hallowed for 4 seconds (2 metres): enemies on it take 10% more damage and your hits on them have +10% chance to critically strike.

nodes.Name: Glass Vigil
nodes.Text: While you channel a skill, hits no longer stop your Energy Shield recharge: it keeps recharging at half speed until the delay ends.

nodes.Name: Graveborn Fury
nodes.Text: While you move, a fresh corpse within 1.5 metres is consumed for a Fury charge (at most 2 a second).

nodes.Name: Running Doctrine
nodes.Text: While you move, your Hunter's Marks jump to the nearest unmarked enemy within 10 metres when the Marked one dies.

nodes.Name: Lone Blade
nodes.Text: While wielding a one-handed Sword with nothing in your off hand, +40% to Critical Strike Multiplier.

nodes.Name: Open Tome
nodes.Text: While holding a Tome, your Spells have 30% reduced Mana cost and 10% more Cast Speed.

nodes.Name: Hammer Choir
nodes.Text: Each Orbiting Hammer circling you gives Judgement 1.5% more damage (at most 9%).

nodes.Name: Patient Edge
nodes.Text: After you use Sheathe, the next 3 Attack skills you use within 5 seconds are critical hits (every hit for 0.75 seconds after each use).
nodes.Price: 10% less Critical Strike Chance.

nodes.Name: Pyre Saint
nodes.Text: Fresh corpses inside your Pyre of Faith burn out as holy fire: one every half second bursts in 2 metres for Fire damage equal to a share of its life (4.2% below Rupture Level 50, 8.4% at 50-99, 9.6% from 100).

nodes.Name: Reed Wind
nodes.Text: Each enemy your Movement skills hit gives you an Edge for 6 seconds (at most 10, Thousand Cuts counts): 2% more attack speed each.

nodes.Name: Elemental Cadence
nodes.Text: When you cast a Fire, Cold or Lightning spell after a spell of another element, that element counts for 4 seconds: 4% more spell damage for each element counting (up to 2).

nodes.Name: Iron Momentum
nodes.Text: While you channel a skill with a two-handed weapon, each metre you travel gives you 1 Momentum (at most 10): 2% more damage each. You lose all Momentum when you stop.

nodes.Name: Falconer's Eye
nodes.Text: Your critical hits on an enemy with a Hunter's Mark give it one more Mark.

nodes.Name: Quiet Ruin
nodes.Text: 20% of your Melee and Orbit hit damage is laid on the enemy as Entropy instead of striking. Sheathe implodes all your Entropy within 6 metres at once as Chaos damage, 30% more. Iaido Thrust implodes the Entropy of each enemy it passes through.
nodes.Price: Your Entropy never implodes on its own. It fades 8 seconds after it was last laid.

nodes.Name: Grave Debt
nodes.Text: 25% of your minions' hit damage is laid on the enemy as your Entropy instead of striking. When one of your minions dies or a corpse bursts within 4 metres of an enemy, that enemy's Entropy implodes at once as Chaos damage, 20% more.
nodes.Price: Your minions have 15% less maximum Life.

nodes.Name: Forsworn Crusade
nodes.Text: 25% of your Holy hit damage is laid on the enemy as Entropy instead of striking. Vowbreak implodes all your Entropy within 8 metres at once as Chaos damage, 25% more.
nodes.Price: After a Vowbreak your Vow stays locked 30% longer.

nodes.Name: Patient Ruin
nodes.Text: Your hits cannot deal critical strikes.

nodes.Name: Entropic Overload
nodes.Text: 30% of your Spell hit damage is laid on the enemy as Entropy instead of striking. Your Spell critical strikes implode your Entropy on that enemy at once as Chaos damage, 20% more.
nodes.Price: Your Energy Shield does not protect you from Poison and Chaos damage.

nodes.Name: Hungering Graves
nodes.Text: When one of your minions kills an enemy, your Entropy on other enemies within 3 metres of it implodes at once as Chaos damage.

nodes.Name: Blood Ledger
nodes.Text: 25% of your Melee hit damage is laid on the enemy as Entropy instead of striking. Your Slam hits implode your Entropy on each enemy they strike at once as Chaos damage, 5% more.
nodes.Price: 15% less maximum Life and Energy Shield.

nodes.Name: Ruin Fletching
nodes.Text: 10% of your Projectile hit damage (not Rain of Arrows) is laid on the enemy as Entropy instead of striking. When an enemy reaches 10 Hunter's Marks, your Entropy on it implodes at once as Chaos damage, 25% more, and its Marks are spent.
nodes.Price: Your Projectiles that lay Entropy do not Chain or Fork.

nodes.Name: Heart Waygate
nodes.Flavour: Links to the 6 other Waygates.

nodes.Name: Butcher's Ledger
nodes.Text: Bleeding from your Slam critical strikes keeps 30% of their extra critical damage.
nodes.Price: -60% to Critical Strike Multiplier.

nodes.Name: Honed Wound
nodes.Text: Bleeding from your Melee critical strikes keeps 35% of their extra critical damage.
nodes.Price: You have 25% less Critical Strike Chance.

nodes.Name: Kindled Heart
nodes.Text: Ignites from your Brand critical strikes keep 30% of their extra critical damage.
nodes.Price: -60% to Critical Strike Multiplier.

nodes.Name: Searing Verdict
nodes.Text: Ignites from your Projectile critical strikes keep 30% of their extra critical damage.
nodes.Price: You deal 10% less damage.

nodes.Name: Hasty Rot
nodes.Text: Poison from your Duration skill critical strikes keeps 35% of their extra critical damage.
nodes.Price: 20% reduced Ailment duration.

nodes.Name: Ripping Barbs
nodes.Text: Bleeding from your Bow critical strikes keeps 25% of their extra critical damage.
nodes.Price: Your Bleeding deals 10% less damage.

nodes.Name: Deep Battery
nodes.Flavour: Dig deep enough and the mountain lends you its engines.

nodes.Name: Cairn Garrison
nodes.Flavour: Every cairn on the road was once a sentry. Some still are.

nodes.Name: Bone Bastion
nodes.Flavour: The dead make patient gunners.
